Shift-shaft seal: 0–0.1 mm in 2024 PDF 250/251; 2025 PDF 255 has 0–1.0 mm. Both use LS. An initial low-resolution S reading for 2025 was withdrawn after enlarged source review; no grease discrepancy remains.
Crank diagram 2024 PDF 268/270 identifies M grease on crank only; 2025 diagram has additional balancer arrow. Bearings remain oiled per exact 2024 case diagrams.
Painted friction plates identified by blue paint around pawl circumference; exact 2024 pack diagram retained.
